title: Terminology Consistency Spec
description: Rules ensuring Canonical Names, aliases, and multilingual forms stay consistent. Specification only.

rules.statement: One Canonical Name per KR-*; aliases never create a second canonical identity.
canonical_index.canonical_key MUST be unique and map to exactly one record_id.
If glossary preferred form exists, Canonical Name MUST match or document an approved deviation.
Same concept cited in multiple records SHOULD use identical Vietnamese/Chinese/Pinyin strings when known.
Deprecated spellings belong in alias_index with alias_kind deprecated/historical — not as new KR-*.
Edge type synonyms in prose (e.g. SUPPORTS) SHOULD map to SUPPORTED_BY at index/manifest time.
